# quicknode_kv_list (Data Source)

Items in a Quicknode Key-Value Store list. A missing list reads as empty.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read a list that a Streams filter maintains.
data "quicknode_kv_list" "tracked_wallets" {
  key = "tracked-wallets"
}

output "tracked_wallet_count" {
  value = length(data.quicknode_kv_list.tracked_wallets.items)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Name of the list.

### Read-Only

- `items` (Set of String) Items in the list.
